title: Haier 8kg 300 Series Heat Pump Dryer $629 (via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys / $637 @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: Haier 8kg 300 Series Heat Pump Dryer $629 (via Price Check Button) + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ The Good Guys / $637 @ Harvey Norman

[ChipsChicky] Can someone recommend a good Washer dryer combo?
[Skinnerr] News to me that that even exists as they've always been separate appliances.
[ATangk] Those are awful in general. Use a shittonne of water for the wash dry cycle.
[pandadude] There aren't any good ones.
Whatever you do, don't get a Hisense i8 Washer Dryer. The problem with a lot of the washer dryer is the dryer function is tiny and it uses water during the drying function. When it breaks your clothes come out more wet then then it was washed. Had this problem on the Electrolux 900 washer dryer.
You can't get this on a dryer alone.
[Jimbo24] I have a Miele WTR870WPM. It's a fantastic washer dryer combo. I had seperate machine and heat pump dryer that i had to downsize for my tiny apartment.
Bought it at Miele Clearance Centre for $2500 with 10 year warranty (RRP $4299 + $650 10 year warranty)
[stevelo] Except space is really limited or washer and dryer can’t be stacked for some reason, I wouldn’t recommend 2 in 1.
Their energy rating usually worse and less efficient, anything goes wrong mean both washer and dryer gone (yeah, more parts in one machine means more problems), if you have multiple washes and dry = you can’t do it at the same time after first wash.
I prefer stack my dryer on top the washer, 2 separate machines working at the same time (ie washing all rooms bedsheets, blankets or after holiday)
[tenpercent] It tries to, but only in Summer. That's why days get longer.
[ltbp] If you are in VIC, you might claim $70 as per https://www.energy.vic.gov.au/victorian-energy-upgrades/prod…
[dehaznkidxd] "No locations in Australia with your item" on TGG, no C&C available unfortunately.
[Matt P] SA you can claim up to $277 rebate if any of these apply to you
* has a residential tenancy agreement with the landlord of the premises and the rent for the premises if $500 or less per week
* holds a Commonwealth Government pensioner concession card
* holds a TPI Gold Repatriation Health Card
* holds a War Widows Gold Repatriation Health Card
* holds a Gold Repatriation Health (EDA)
* holds a Health Care Card (including a Low Income Health Care Card)
* receives the South Australian government energy bill concession
* is actively participating in an energy retailer hardship program
* is actively participating in an energy retailer’s payment plan (offered and applied as per section 50 of the National Energy Retail Law)
* has received a referral from a registered member of the South Australian Financial Counsellors Association (SAFCA)
https://yess.net.au/our-services/appliance-rebate/#rebate-ap…
[Bargainboss99] Hailer is bad support brand ! Took 2 months to replace a DOA washing machine - that was flooding the laundry.
Machine is good after replacement but if I had known the pain I would have to go through I would have just gone with some Aldi brand.
